method: Whisper tiny.en re-transcription of final mixed MP4, compared with intended narration. ASR differences need interpretation; this is not proof of word-perfect audio.
transcript: If you already build Power BI reports, learn what happens before the chart. Fabric brings ingestion, engineering, storage, analytics, and reporting into one platform. Start with a lake house. Understand where the data lands and how its tables are organized. Then trace an ingestion pipeline. What arrives, what changes, and what happens when a run fails? Keep SQL and Power BI. Add the shared data layer underneath them. Fabric data agents can turn questions into queries against supported data sources. That makes a clean model and clear permissions useful beyond the report itself. Build one small workflow from source to report. Explain each step and show its output.
